pages.text: The monster oils are strong but temporal additives that you can apply to your swords and axes, these oils gave you more damage against some specific types of monster.$(br2)To apply these additives, hold your weapon with your main hand and the oil with your offhand and use it, you also can apply them directly inside your inventory.
This added damage it's independent of any kind of enchantment your weapon could have.

Each oil has a number of uses, each use being one hit, these uses are going to go down with every hit you make with the weapon, $(n)independently if the oil boosts your damage against your current target$().$(br2)Similar to $(l:tcots_witcher:concoctions/potions)potions$(/l), each type of oil has three levels; $(o)Normal$(), $(o)Enhanced$() and $(o)Superior$(). Each one being stronger and having more uses than the last. They also can be $(l:tcots_witcher:alchemy_basics/refilling)refilled$(/l).

$(l)$(#fc5454)List of Oils$()$(br)$(li)$(#b71520)Necrophage Oil$(): $(#000000)Extra damage against necrophages and undead.$()$(li)$(#cc341d)Ogroid Oil$(): $(#000000)Extra damage against ogroids and piglins.$()$(li)$(#411106)Beast Oil$(): $(#000000)Extra damage against beasts and animals.$()$(li)$(#00752b)Hanged Man's Venom$(): $(#000000)Extra damage against villagers, illagers and humans.$()
